spatial_gui_extras.config.option.capture: Maximum image capture rate, from 1 to 120 FPS. Actual updates depend on rendering, compression and network capacity; no extra playback buffer is added.
spatial_gui_extras.config.option.enabled: Enable local interaction extensions and multiplayer GUI sharing.
spatial_gui_extras.config.option.followD: Wait before each new response. In stationary mode, timing starts when pointer and view stop moving.
Allow panel following while carrying an inventory item.
spatial_gui_extras.config.option.followP: Move the first-person panel towards your view after looking outside it.
spatial_gui_extras.config.option.followS: Higher values make each movement settle more gently.
spatial_gui_extras.config.option.followV: Allow the panel to follow upward and downward looking.
spatial_gui_extras.config.option.followW: Outside the panel, wait until the pointer and first-person view stay still for the response delay. Movement restarts the wait.
spatial_gui_extras.config.option.keyfram: Refresh the entire image at this interval. Shorter intervals can help new viewers fill in the image sooner but increase traffic.
spatial_gui_extras.config.option.linearF: Enable smooth texture filtering. Disable it for sharp pixel edges.
spatial_gui_extras.config.option.maxVisi: When the limit is exceeded, show the nearest panels first. Limits drawing, not how many panels are received.
spatial_gui_extras.config.option.occlude: When enabled, world geometry can cover remote panels. When disabled, panels remain visible through world geometry.
spatial_gui_extras.config.option.overflo: Keep a carried inventory item visible when looking outside a first-person panel.
spatial_gui_extras.config.option.panelOp: Multiply remote panel opacity by this value. 1.0 preserves the sender’s opacity and animation; 0 hides the panels.
spatial_gui_extras.config.option.receive: Display shared player body and head orientation. When disabled, use the normal server pose.
Show other players’ panels. Disabling this releases remote textures and does not stop sharing your own panel.
spatial_gui_extras.config.option.shareBa: 6144 KiB/s is 6 MiB/s. The server may enforce a lower limit. This is a bandwidth budget, not a guaranteed frame rate.
spatial_gui_extras.config.option.shareGu: Publish your Spatial GUI panel to nearby players. Disabling this still lets you view other players. Requires a compatible server relay.
spatial_gui_extras.config.option.shareIn: Share the current indicator (follow Spatial GUI)
Share the indicator currently used by Spatial GUI, including outside the panel. Does not change the local pointer or crosshair.
spatial_gui_extras.config.option.shareMa: Maximum changed tiles processed in one capture. Larger values can refresh faster but increase CPU work.
Preserve aspect ratio and only downscale larger images. Maximum dimensions are limited by the sharing protocol. Higher values use more bandwidth.
spatial_gui_extras.config.option.sharePa: 1.0 is the sender’s original size. Only changes the remote panels you see, not your own panel or other viewers.
spatial_gui_extras.config.option.sharePo: Share player orientation while a spatial GUI is active.
20 ms allows up to 50 updates per second, bounded by game and network performance. Lower values increase packet traffic.
spatial_gui_extras.config.option.shareTi: Pixel block size for incremental updates. Changing this restarts your outgoing stream to keep the tile grid consistent.
spatial_gui_extras.config.option.shareVi: Use this range for remote panels and eligible nearby sharing peers. The current server relay range is at most 48 blocks.
spatial_gui_extras.config.option.statist: Log periodic capture and transfer statistics. Errors and warnings are always logged.
spatial_gui_extras.config.save_error.des: The previous settings are still active. Check the game log for details.
spatial_gui_extras.config.title: Spatial GUI Extras
